scope: fresh owned Chromium guest profile using the published Store CRX; no reusable designated guest identity was available

behavior.opening: real offscreen HTTP 200 POST, is_new=true, terminal grounded assistant answer with opening page code and stages
behavior.same_conversation_followup: second real offscreen HTTP 200 POST before reload, is_new=false, same conversation fingerprint, later separate grounded assistant reply with follow-up page code and heading, guest session still absent
behavior.post_reload: new real offscreen HTTP 200 POST, is_new=true, different conversation fingerprint, terminal grounded assistant reply after panel reload
behavior.backend: public health/version SHA captured before and after the run; a changed observed SHA invalidates an otherwise passing result
behavior.retention: CDP POST data is parsed transiently; only an irreversible truncated conversation fingerprint and is_new flag are retained; no guest authorization values are written

verification.red_proof: scratch-copy return-bypass mutant made the conversation sequence test fail with missing expected followup_must_continue_conversation exception
verification.native_browser_or_heavy_run: not launched by this implementation lane

limits: The next guarded hosted public CRX acceptance must run against the current live server before same-conversation guest completion can be claimed. A fresh owned profile tests that guest scope; it does not prove preservation of an existing installed profile or allowance exhaustion.
